description: This file contains a test suite for the main index render tree of a React application, specifically testing if the app mounts without errors using React Testing Library, Jest mocks, and ReactDOM's createRoot method.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up a root DOM element and spies on ReactDOM.createRoot before each test.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Cleans up the DOM element and restores mocks after each test.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines a test case that checks if the React app mounts without throwing errors.
